confidence.note: No pre-2016 CPC for 'website builder', no dated Strikingly pricing, and no archived pricing pages; churn for $19/yr products is a benchmark.

gross_margin.note: About 90% after Stripe's $0.85 per $19 charge and hosting cents: static one-page sites are nearly free to serve.

ltv_cac.note: LTV ~$36 vs organic CAC ~$22 (estimate): 1.6. Paid search is out of reach at $19/yr.

pricing_power.note: Free tiers (Wix, Weebly, about.me) anchor near $0; $19/yr undercuts Squarespace Cover at $36/yr rather than commanding a premium.

build_effort.note: A hosted drag-and-drop builder with custom domains and SSL is 2-3 months of side-project work (estimate).

skills_match.note: Solo developer covers the build; design taste and marketing are unproven (assumption).

capital_needed.note: Hosting from $5/month and S3 at $0.03/GB: the $1,000 budget covers years of runway.

time_to_mvp.note: About 10 weeks to a paid Pro tier at side-project pace (estimate).

sales_cycle.note: A $19/year self-serve purchase is an impulse buy: no committee, same-day checkout.

channel_readiness.note: Product Hunt launches bring thousands of visitors, but the founder has no audience of their own.

search_demand.note: Wix had 77M registered users; 55% of US very small businesses still had no website in 2015.

trend.note: Wix revenue grew 43% in 2015 to $203.5M and premium subs grew 43%.

willingness_to_pay.note: People pay (1.77M Wix premium subs) but only ~2.3% of registered users convert.

free_alternatives.note: Wix, Weebly (30M sites) and about.me (5M users) do a free one-page site; R5: free alternative hit, capped at 2.

competitor_density.note: 9 competitors found incl. Squarespace Cover Pages and Strikingly; strong_competitor hit (R5 <= 3).

differentiation.note: One specific edge: price, $19/yr vs $36/yr for Squarespace Cover; the rest is simplicity.

legal_regulatory.note: Needs a DMCA agent filing and abuse handling: free subdomain hosts carried 14% of phishing in 1H2014.

platform_dependency.note: Owns the product, domain and data; relies on commodity hosting with many substitutes.

market_risk.note: Durable need: personal and small-business web presence keeps growing with mobile.

skills.note: Developer skills cover the product; no track record in design or SaaS marketing (assumption).

assets.note: No audience, list or template following stated; $1,000 only.

interest.note: Side project: curiosity, not stated domain passion (assumption).

sam.reasoning: 10% of Wix's 1.77M premium subs assumed to be single-page or personal sites = 177k x $19/yr

som.reasoning: 0.3% of SAM in year 1: ~530 Pro customers x $19/yr

price.reasoning: Founder's stated Pro price: $19 per year, billed annually

variable_cost_per_unit.reasoning: Stripe 2.9% x 19 + 0.30 = 0.85; hosting/bandwidth ~0.50; support ~0.50 per Pro user per year

churn_monthly_pct.reasoning: Mid-range of SMB SaaS churn 3-7%/month (Tunguz 2015) and 5.4% median (Point Nine 2015); annual billing pulls it lower

conversion_rate_pct.reasoning: Wix FY2015: 1.77M premium subs / 77M registered users = 2.3% free-to-paid

cac.reasoning: Launch work 40 h x $25/h = $1,000 / (2,000 free sign-ups from Product Hunt + Show HN x 2.3%) = 46 Pro users

payback_months.reasoning: CAC 21.7 / (17.15 / 12 monthly gross profit); annual upfront billing recovers $17.15 on day 1

fixed_costs_month.reasoning: $5 server (DigitalOcean 2013 price) + ~$5 storage/CDN + ~$5 domain, email, DMCA filing amortised

break_even_customers_per_month.reasoning: 15 / 1.43 monthly gross profit per Pro customer = ~11 Pro customers in total

time_to_first_revenue_weeks.reasoning: ~10 weeks of side-project build to a Pro tier with custom domains, then launch day

launch_reason: The founder's stated launch market, and home of the Product Hunt and Hacker News audiences.
cheapest_test: Landing page with 3 demo one-page sites and a $19/yr Pro pre-order button, posted to Show HN, Product Hunt and r/web_design for 7 days.
kill_criteria: Fewer than 300 waitlist sign-ups within 7 days of the Show HN / Product Hunt post -> stop
Fewer than 10 paid $19 pre-orders by day 7 -> stop
Free-to-Pro conversion below 1% after 60 days live -> stop

rescue.change: Cut scope to a 2-week MVP: fixed templates, no drag-and-drop, Pro = custom domain only, then launch on Product Hunt and Show HN
rescue.why: time_to_mvp 2 -> 4 and build_effort 2.5 -> 4: revenue in weeks, not months
rescue.requires: Discipline to ship a narrow product

rescue.change: Build distribution first: publish free one-page templates and a 'made with' badge on every free site
rescue.why: channel_readiness 2.5 -> 4 and assets 1.5 -> 3: owned, compounding channel
rescue.requires: Design skill to make templates people share

rescue.change: Niche down to one ICP (freelance designers or job seekers) with a tailored Pro bundle

type_checks.note: SMB SaaS churns 3-7%/month (Tunguz 2015); at $19/yr that caps LTV near $36, shown in ltv_cac = 2.
Targets people with no site yet; a one-page site is cheap to rebuild, so switching costs neither block entry nor protect retention.
